rotation.marker: Sun Nov 15 — 90-day confirmation + first Quarterly Lead Review

openingMessage: If you don't have time to do it right, when will you have time to do it over?
openingWhy: A rushed handover — 'she's bled down, you're good' — with one valve still holding pressure is how the night hand ends up wearing what the day hand skipped. The five minutes a real handover takes is the cheapest time in the oilfield.
leadershipThought: This industry rewards preparation, effort, and ownership — not excuses. You help power homes, hospitals, schools, and communities. Take pride in the standard you represent.
